title: The gharial's last stronghold
caption:
One river holds most of the world's gharials.

Smithsonian scientists report the population fell by 58% between 1997 and 2006.

Source: IUCN Red List (Lang, Chowfin & Ross 2019); Smithsonian's National Zoo; IUCN Crocodile Specialist Group. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
